title: Bases loaded, one wild pitch: everybody up, two score, one runner moves twice

expect.note: Rule 9.13 charges a wild pitch per *pitch*, never per runner: four advances, two runs, one charge. r2 appears twice — 2→3 with the pack, then 3→4 on her own — which is legal and is the case a naive per-advance count gets wrong. Entered exactly this way in the simulator (2026-08-30): §11.1's one-tap 'all runners up one' wrote e2–e4, then the field surface wrote e5. No touch is recorded because a wild pitch's physics is the *absence* of one (§13.2), and no error follows for the same reason. The count still advances on ball two.
